answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained, verifiable honest service rather than gained once and retained indefinitely. In the EigenTrust graph, a freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality; without reciprocal paths to trusted peers, its score cannot propagate enough to pass consensus. Like an island resisting the tide, the network makes a brief voyage of fabricated identities ineffective.
